name: self-improve
description: Self Improve: learns from a session when you mark it done, keeps soul.md (facts about you and how Claude should respond) in step with Hindsight, and tunes skills over time with your approval.

mode.title: Review mode
mode.description: How much Self Improve does on its own. off: nothing runs. suggest: everything waits in /learn for your OK. controlled: low-risk lessons apply themselves. advanced: validated skill drafts apply too. Default: suggest.

soulBank.title: Soul bank name
soulBank.description: The Hindsight bank that holds the facts in soul.md. Default: soul.

hindsightUrl.title: Hindsight address
hindsightUrl.description: Address of your Hindsight server, like http://localhost:8888. Default (empty): use apiUrl from ~/.hindsight/coding-agent.json; if neither exists, Hindsight is skipped.

learnModel.title: Learn model
learnModel.description: The model that reads a finished session, one call per run. Default: haiku.

rewriteModel.title: Rewrite model
rewriteModel.description: The model that drafts a rewrite of a skill that keeps getting corrected. Default: sonnet.

maxCalls.title: Max model calls per run
maxCalls.description: Most model calls one run may make. Default: 4. 0 means no limit.

maxTokens.title: Max tokens per run
maxTokens.description: Most tokens one run may use. Default: 60000. 0 means no limit.

maxChanges.title: Max changes per run
maxChanges.description: Most changes one run may apply on its own (controlled and advanced modes). Default: 5. 0 means no limit.

dailyUsd.title: Daily spend cap (USD)
dailyUsd.description: Most estimated spend on learn calls in one day. Default: 0.5. 0 means no cap.

soulCap.title: soul.md size at session start
soulCap.description: Characters of soul.md each session starts with, most important first (200 to 6000). Default: 1500.

extraSkillDirs.title: Extra skill folders
extraSkillDirs.description: Extra folders that hold <skill>/SKILL.md for Self Improve to tune, separated by semicolons. Default: none.
